professionalSummary: Experienced project manager with a proven track record of delivering 17 new restaurant openings across the Midlands and the North West, managing all aspects from site handover to first trading day.
experienceHighlights: Planned and executed 14‑week opening programmes for each site, covering shopfit, kitchen installation, recruitment and training.
Coordinated kitchen‑equipment deliveries, utility connections and premises‑licence milestones, maintaining a dedicated milestone tracker per site.
Presented monthly programme status and cost reports to the development committee, including forecasts to completion.
Collected and disseminated first‑week operations feedback to inform future openings.
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised milestone tracker for a single site, detailing handover, shopfit completion, gas safety certificate, premises licence grant, staff training and first trading day with planned and actual dates.

evidence.text: Planned each opening as a 14-week programme from site handover to first trading day, covering shopfit, kitchen installation, recruitment and training.

In 2023 the candidate agreed 23 contract variations with shopfitting contractors within a £25,000 delegated limit and chaired the June 2023 dispute meeting over delayed joinery, whose minutes record the settlement the candidate agreed.

Collected feedback from the first-week operations teams after each opening and circulated a summary to the property team.
